data.name: Mohtashim
data.gender_notes: Mohtashim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A person who is tested or put to the test
data.long_meaning: The name Mohtashim is derived from the Arabic word 'Mahasasa', which means to put to the test or to examine. In Islamic context, it signifies a person who is tested or put to the test, and it is believed that such trials are a part of Allah's plan to strengthen one's faith and character. The name Mohtashim carries the meaning “A person who is tested or put to the test” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mohtashim usually hope their child will grow to embody a person who is tested or put to the test and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A test or trial from Allah that strengthens one's faith and character
data.etymology: Mohtashim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A person who is tested or put to the test.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mohtashim total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
